#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "usage: $0 RELEASE_DIRECTORY" >&2
    exit 64
fi

case $1 in
    /*) release=$1 ;;
    *)  release=$base/$1 ;;
esac

if [ ! -d "$release" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "publish: release directory not found: $1" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "$release/MANIFEST" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "publish: refusing release without MANIFEST: $1" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Resolve the validated directory before constructing the link.  The temporary
# link is created beside current so GNU mv completes the switch with one atomic
# rename(2); readers therefore never observe a missing current path.
release=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$release" && pwd -P)
tmp=$base/.current.$$
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3 15
ln -s -- "$release" "$tmp"
mv -Tf -- "$tmp" "$base/current"
trap - 0 1 2 3 15
ATOMIC_PUBLISH_EOF
chmod 0755 bin/publish.new
mv -f bin/publish.new bin/publish
/bin/sh -n bin/publish
printf '%s\n' 'installed publisher:'
sed -n '1,240p' bin/publish
printf 'current=%s\n' "$(readlink current)"
find releases -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -printf '%f\n' | sort
